_comment: Copy this to ~/.config/albus/mcp-config.json and edit. Or set ALBUS_MCP_CONFIG to point at your own path. The bot resolves in this order: env var → ~/.config/albus/mcp-config.json → this example as last-resort fallback.
_honcho_hint: The bot uses Honcho as its long-term memory backend, addressed as mcp__honcho__*. Replace the command/args/env below with your own Honcho MCP server invocation. Set HONCHO_API_KEY (and any base URL / workspace) to your real values. Do NOT commit real keys to this file.
